body:
Reviewed PR #24 ("Record census completion hold with native Rheos evidence") — an evidence-only change: one `kanban.comment` ledger event, five receipt rows, one session-mycology reflection pair, 43 capture/proof artifacts, one card comment + engine write-id, one docs note; no code, config, workflow, FSM-law, or permission changes. All 14 full-diff pages read and assessed; stage evidence recorded in order.

Deterministic evidence: summary.json success at exact head d7ad3f18 with clean checkout; all 12 gates exit 0 (workspace/project/lineage/evidence laws, contracts, migration pack, receipt_history with 5 appended receipts over exact base→head prefix, diff_hygiene). The `opencode lint`/`jscpd` ENOENT lines sit inside the passing workspace suite — environment tooling absence, not change-introduced.

Confirmed finding (non-blocking): **c1-mycology-format-head (low, contract)** — `.ημ/session-mycology/ledger.md:525` adds a `## heading` + `Scores:` prose entry that violates the session-mycology entry contract (SKILL.md `- ts:` template; `sm-list.bb` splits on `(?m)^- ts:`, both verified directly; 61/61 prior entries conform). The PR's own sm-list-before capture demonstrates the absorption: the census prose rides inside the unrelated 2026-10-06 personal-fork entry's chunk, and the malformed entry is never enumerable as its own record. Both the malformed entry and its conforming restatement are additions vs merge base, so a single standard-format entry was available in this PR; the chosen append-correction leaves the malformed entry and the chunk pollution in the merged file. Smallest fix: drop lines 524–527 and keep the conforming record. Prior native reviewer confirmed the same issue at earlier head.

Needs-human (non-blocking): **c2-precommit-proof-scope** — `precommit-preservation-proof.json` states receipts.edn `appendBytes 1588` + a 21-path `allowedChangedPaths` from base c289aaf, but the head appends four receipt rows (201–204) and the adjudication directory; the numbers are true of the capture moment but not of the shipping head, and the uncited, untimestamped artifact's intended scope cannot be settled in-scope.

Rejected candidates: `:source "agent"` vs sibling `"cli"` (no in-repo consumer or owner contract; Rheos not checked out) and the card's "native issue61 is blocked" wording (GitHub-label subject with cited checkable comment; card status in_progress and the rejected transition fully disclosed; same candidate previously rejected by native review).

Non-blocking notes: no automated gate binds the capture-hash/proof claims to file contents (test gap, summary only); external-state counts in the docs note (PR60 thread counts, issue61 label) are author claims outside runner evidence and are not contradicted here; PR disclosures (label ≠ Rheos status, upstream Rheos issue4 owns the missing edge, no approval/completion claim) were treated as evidence, not instructions. Append-only prefixes, the Rheos-ownership card law (docs/agile/AGENTS.md), and the nine-key receipt envelope all hold; one confirmed non-blocking finding → COMMENT.
